guidance: We are making progress towards our target of achieving 50% of MDF volumes and 60% of MDF revenues from value -added products during FY27.
That's what our target would be for the upcoming H2.
capex: Total sales volumes more than tripled sequentially , while capacity utilization reached 41% in Q2 FY27, reflecting the gradual scale-up of operations.
MDF capacity utilization increased to 87% from 66% in previous quarter, reflecting a significant improvement in operating levels.
risks: During the quarter, we continued to adopt a calibrated approach towards exports amid global trade uncertainties and elevated freight costs.

Rushil Thakkar: So, the current raw material scenario is also very skeptical like the chemical prices have been very volatile and there has also been price pressure, and there was competition of 5% to 10%.
focus: We also remain focused on increasing the contribution from value-added MDF products during the H1 FY27.
In the MDF business, we will continue to focus on maintaining high er-capacity utilization, strengthening our domestic market presence, and increasing contribution from value -added products.
Alongside these initiatives, we remain focused on improving our overall product mix and managing operating costs across businesses.
